title: Finite algebraic envelopes and the Boone–Higman conjecture
summary: We prove the Boone–Higman conjecture. A finitely generated group has decidable word problem if and only if it embeds in a finitely presented simple group.

review.reason: Proves the Boone–Higman conjecture relating decidable word problems to simple group embeddings.
